delete.title: Delete Account
delete.message:
Are you sure you want to permanently delete your account?

Once you confirm, you will be automatically signed out and your account will be scheduled for deletion.

Grace Period: Your account will remain in a recoverable state for 30 days. During this period, you may cancel the deletion request by logging back into the app and restoring your account.

If you need assistance, please contact our support team.
